title: packit: use fedora-all with version_update_mask
body:
Currently our Packit configuration had to be updated whenever a new stable Fedora was branched. This change should make sure that we don't have to do that.

The manually maintained Fedora branch list was replaced with `fedora-stable` so new Fedoras are included automatically. `version_update_mask` is used to ensure that those releases only ever stay on one major version of Podman.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
None
```
